meta.note: The 2025 round covers calendar year 2025 (January to December): a different reference period from the financial-year rounds, so a separate bundle, never joined to them. Every row MoSPI publishes for this table, values as served, including its published "All" totals; each series is named by all of its dimensions. Per-1000 distributions are integers and can miss 1,000 by a few parts from rounding. Rupee values are nominal.
